info.name: Music Favorites API
info.description:
Music Favorites API — CST-391 Milestone 3  
Author: Jose Beltran Veles

REST API built with Express, Node.js, TypeScript, and MySQL.

Base URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000](http://127.0.0.1:3000)

Features:

- Create, read, update, and delete albums.
    
- Add, view, and remove favorites for a specified user.
    
- Prevent duplicate favorites.
    
- Validate input and handle missing records.
    

Send POST and PUT bodies as application/json.

Response codes:  
200 — Successful read, update, or deletion.  
201 — Album or favorite created.  
400 — Invalid input.  
404 — Record not found.  
409 — Duplicate favorite.  
500 — Unexpected database failure.

Authentication and role authorization are deferred. User IDs  
select records and do not authenticate callers.

For album CRUD demonstrations, create an album first and use  
the returned album_id for subsequent GET, PUT, and DELETE requests.  
The previously tested album 3 has been deleted.

request.description:
Returns all albums in the catalog.

Method: GET  
URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums)  
Request body: None  
Authentication: None

200 OK: Returns a JSON array of albums. Each album contains  
album_id, title, artist, description, year, and image.  
An empty catalog returns \[\].

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to retrieve albums."}

Returns one album by its ID.

Method: GET  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/1](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/1)  
Request body: None  
Authentication: None

Path parameter:  
id — Required positive integer identifying the album.

200 OK: Returns a JSON object containing album_id, title,  
artist, description, year, and image.

400 Bad Request:  
{"message":"Album ID must be a positive integer."}

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"Album not found."}

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to retrieve album."}

request.description:
Creates an album in the catalog.

Method: POST  
URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums)  
Authentication: None  
Content-Type: application/json

Example request body:  
{  
"title": "Abbey Road",  
"artist": "The Beatles",  
"description": "Album created through the REST API.",  
"year": 1969,  
"image": ""  
}

Required fields:  
title — Nonblank string, maximum 255 characters.  
artist — Nonblank string, maximum 255 characters.  
year — Integer from 1000 to 9999.

Optional fields:  
description — String, maximum 10000 characters; defaults to "".  
image — String, maximum 2048 characters; defaults to "".

201 Created: Returns the created album, including its generated  
album_id. The Location header contains /api/albums/{album_id}.  
Use the returned ID for later read, update, and delete requests.

400 Bad Request: Invalid field types, values, or lengths.

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to create album."}

request.description:
Updates an existing album.

Method: PUT  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/3](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/3)  
Authentication: None  
Content-Type: application/json

Path parameter:  
id — Required positive integer identifying an existing album.  
Replace 3 with the ID returned by Create Album.

Example request body:  
{  
"title": "Abbey Road",  
"artist": "The Beatles",  
"description": "Updated through the REST API for Milestone 3.",  
"year": 1969,  
"image": ""  
}

Required fields:  
title — Nonblank string, maximum 255 characters.  
artist — Nonblank string, maximum 255 characters.  
year — Integer from 1000 to 9999.

Optional fields:  
description — String, maximum 10000 characters.  
image — String, maximum 2048 characters.  
Omitting either optional field resets it to an empty string.

200 OK: Returns the updated album as a JSON object.  
Verify the saved changes using Get Album by ID.

400 Bad Request: Invalid album ID or request fields.

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"Album not found."}

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to update album."}

Deletes an album from the catalog.

Method: DELETE  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/3](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/albums/3)  
Request body: None  
Authentication: None

Path parameter:  
id — Required positive integer identifying an existing album.  
Replace 3 with the ID returned by Create Album.

200 OK:  
{  
"message": "Album deleted successfully.",  
"album_id": 3  
}

Deleting an album also deletes its related favorites through  
the database's ON DELETE CASCADE constraint.

Verify deletion using Get Album by ID; it should return 404.

400 Bad Request:  
{"message":"Album ID must be a positive integer."}

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"Album not found."}

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to delete album."}

Returns the favorites associated with a specified user.

Method: GET  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites)  
Request body: None  
Authentication: None

Path parameter:  
userId — Required positive integer identifying an existing user.  
This ID selects records; it does not authenticate the caller.

200 OK: Returns a JSON array ordered by favorite_id.  
Each entry contains favorite_id, user_id, album_id, created_at,  
title, artist, description, year, and image.

An existing user with no favorites receives \[\].

400 Bad Request:  
{"message":"User ID must be a positive integer."}

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"User not found."}

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to retrieve favorites."}

Adds an existing album to a specified user's favorites.

Method: POST  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites)  
Authentication: None  
Content-Type: application/json

Path parameter:  
userId — Required positive integer identifying an existing user.  
This ID selects records; it does not authenticate the caller.

Required request body:  
{  
"album_id": 1  
}

album_id must be a positive integer identifying an existing album.

201 Created: Example response:  
{  
"message": "Album added to favorites.",  
"favorite_id": 1,  
"user_id": 1,  
"album_id": 1  
}

favorite_id is generated and may differ from this example.  
Verify creation using Get User Favorites.

400 Bad Request:  
{"message":"User ID and album_id must be positive integers."}

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"User or album not found."}

409 Conflict:  
{"message":"This album is already in the user's favorites."}

The unique constraint on (user_id, album_id) prevents duplicates.

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to add favorite."}

Removes an album from a specified user's favorites.

Method: DELETE  
Example URL: [http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites/1](http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/users/1/favorites/1)  
Request body: None  
Authentication: None

Path parameters:  
userId — Required positive integer identifying the user.  
albumId — Required positive integer identifying the album.  
The final URL value is album_id, not favorite_id.

User IDs select records; they do not authenticate callers.

200 OK:  
{  
"message": "Album removed from favorites.",  
"user_id": 1,  
"album_id": 1  
}

The album remains in the catalog.  
Verify removal using Get User Favorites and confirm the album  
still exists using Get Album by ID.

400 Bad Request:  
{"message":"User ID and album ID must be positive integers."}

404 Not Found:  
{"message":"Favorite not found."}

Returned when no favorite matches both IDs, including when  
the user or album does not exist.

500 Internal Server Error:  
{"message":"Unable to remove favorite."}
